theme.name: Assemble Warm Paper & Dark Ink Workspace
theme.mode: Light Warm Bone/Paper (No forced dark theme)

scale.caption_eyebrow: text-xs font-mono font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-[#2F4A66]

project_rail.responsive: Collapsible below 1100px width into header trigger

elements: State Chip: Private Draft / Selected for Review
Concise Factual Status Sentence (checked facts, open conditions, responses)
project_header.rules: Never replace status sentence with readiness percentage or forced metric cards

workspace_toolbar.show_changes_toggle: Show Changes toggle button included in toolbar

graph_canvas.zoom_controls: Bottom-left stacked floating zoom / Fit / pan controls
graph_canvas.interaction: Vertical wheel scroll, Space-drag pan, canvas drag

group_frame.header: Folder Icon + Group Title + Task Count (e.g. '0 of 3')
group_frame.firm_assignment: Displayed as clean status label badge

ai_task.visual: Sparkle badge icon + pulse ring for working, warning indicator for needs input

question_condition.visual: Differentiate unknown/open condition from zero or failed state
question_condition.border: Dashed border #B4690E with light amber background

connectors.proposed_relationship: Visibly marked with dashed animated SVG curve

list_view.mobile_default: Default view on visits below 720px breakpoint

week_view.date_types: Distinguish Target Date, Stated Date, and Provisional Date with subtle badge styles

bottom_composer.position: Centered at bottom of workspace, fixed dock, max-width 760px
bottom_composer.reserved_space: Layout must reserve measured height (e.g., pb-28) so cards are not covered
elements: Add (+) Menu button (Add details, Add source, Add work item, Run checks, Prepare review)
Max 2 quick suggestion pills floating directly above input

conversation_tray.max_height: 40% of workspace height with independent scroll
conversation_tray.open_trigger: Submitting a question or expanding conversation history

inspector_panel.behavior: Temporary slide-over panel on card selection, reduces main canvas width smoothly
inspector_panel.change_receipt: Concise change receipt banner with Undo button and Show Changes toggle

responsive_behavior.desktop: Width >= 1100px: Full side rail (192px), canvas with graph/list/week/report, inspector (360px)
responsive_behavior.tablet: Width < 1100px: Collapse left rail into drawer icon in header
responsive_behavior.mobile: Width < 720px: Default to List view, full-width / full-height detail panels and conversation surfaces with clear Back/Close actions

motion_and_interactions.hover_transitions: transition: background-color 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease
motion_and_interactions.animations: staggered entrance for lists, panel-in smooth slide for inspector and conversation tray
motion_and_interactions.prefers_reduced_motion: Full support via media query (disabled transforms and zeroed animation durations)

testing_and_accessibility.apca_contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for normal body text against #FAF8F5 and #F5F0EB
testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based (e.g. data-testid="workspace-project-rail", data-testid="toolbar-view-graph", data-testid="composer-send-button", data-testid="inspector-panel")

instructions_to_main_agent: Overhaul the Assemble workspace into an AI-composed workspace based on these design specifications.
Preserve Assemble's brand identity: Source Serif 4 for wordmark, warm paper/bone surfaces (#F5F0EB canvas, #FAF8F5 cards), and dark ink typography (#1A2838).
Maintain exact layout specs: 192px left rail (collapsible <1100px), 56px header, 44px toolbar, 760px bottom composer, 360px inspector, 40% height conversation tray.
Ensure all interactive controls and core containers include data-testid attributes.
Do not invent percentage progress metrics; use the factual status sentence in header.
